atomicity.reason: One obligation: set a thermal imbalance warning when the cell temperature spread exceeds 8 K.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: threshold, unit, inputs (highest and lowest valid cell temperature), output (warning on the diagnostic interface) and purpose are all stated.

feasibility.reason: Comparing maximum minus minimum valid cell temperature with 8 K is trivial and consistent with the linked evaluator design.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the parent's explicit observable: when the spread between the warmest and coldest cell grows too wide the workshop is warned, so uneven ageing is caught before it costs capacity.

unambiguity.reason: The trigger is clear but the warning's lifetime is not: 'set ... whenever the spread exceeds 8 K' reads as level-triggered, yet the stated purpose (uneven ageing visible in the workshop) implies the warning must outlive a transient exceedance.
unambiguity.suggestion: State whether the warning follows the spread (with a clear threshold) or is latched until cleared in the workshop.

verifiability.reason: Concrete: apply highest-minus-lowest valid cell temperature spreads of 8.0 K and 8.1 K and check the warning on the diagnostic interface; threshold, unit and strict inequality are stated.

summary: Clear, testable 8 K threshold; unambiguity reduced because the warning's clearing or persistence is not stated.
